scope: Documentation completion across the web and RAG repositories

source_baselines.working_tree: Includes pre-existing local work and this documentation update

method: Read-only Python pathlib/regex checks for file and heading targets, AST comparison of RAG Config fields with example assignments, explicit credential-field allowlist, CSV recalculation, existing unit tests and git diff --check
validation_note: An initial broad suffix-based credential check classified CANVAS_ALLOW_ENV_TOKEN=false as a credential. The check was corrected to use explicit credential fields; the boolean setting was preserved.
boundaries: GitHub targets were checked against local repository files, not remote publication or reviewer permissions.
Mermaid source was reviewed; a renderer was not available for visual validation.
Setup sequences are source-derived; no database initialization or migration was executed.
Recorded application/AI test and benchmark results were not rerun as part of this documentation update.
Historical handoff exports and raw audit measurements were preserved.
No deployment, paid inference, tag, commit, push, access change or academic submission was performed.
Credential-field checking is not a comprehensive secret or Git-history audit.
